name: Event
summary: The menu of the Qatar Event Show 2026 card: your picture across the top with a coloured rule and a dark title strip under it, your event's dates, hours and venue, then the agenda with one button per day, the other options in two columns, and wide buttons to ask a question, continue on WhatsApp and contact you. Without an agenda, three large buttons for what people ask first.
suits: Events, shows and conferences, venues, chambers and any business with a wide picture and a few clear things to do.
